purpose: Freeze the deterministic mapping from authoritative Weekly ETF state and evidence into the required Weekly Review structure without granting delivery or execution authority.

authoritative_inputs.rule: Use only current integrated repository governance; narrative does not override machine state.
Machine-readable state is authoritative for holdings, cash, executed model changes and valuation history.
Use the current canonical pricing lineage and its provenance/freshness status; never substitute stale report prices for current pricing authority.
Only evidence explicitly admissible under current project governance may influence the review; shadow/lab material is non-authoritative unless promoted.
This contract composes existing methodology; it does not silently change thresholds, scoring, product identity or portfolio philosophy.

fail_closed_conditions: attempt to treat shadow, lab or historical report values as current authority

output_contract.ordering_rule: Emit every section exactly once in the listed order. Client layer precedes analyst layer.
output_contract.content_rule: For identical authoritative inputs, evidence set and methodology revision, material classifications, scores, actions, holdings/cash state and continuity output must be reproducible; wording may vary only where it does not change meaning.
output_contract.identity_rule: The assembled review must retain exact references to the authoritative state/pricing/evidence identities consumed for the run so later QA can bind the output to its inputs.

side_effects.note: Assembly may describe recommendations or already-authoritative executed model state, but this contract itself cannot perform or authorize any of these side effects.

product_boundaries: US Weekly ETF identity remains authoritative for this repository
EU UCITS/investability semantics are not imported
FX runtime/output semantics are not imported
no second pricing, portfolio, ledger or state authority is created
deterministic_acceptance: all required input classes resolve to explicit repository paths
required output sections and order are fixed
delivery and financial side effects remain unauthorized
